scientific_reason: Two independently validated slope-based pre-event rescue designs failed the unchanged 0.50 percentage-point per-SD MDE80 criterion. Stage3 therefore changes the estimand rather than tuning another slope model on consumed placebo periods.

price_extension.vendor: Yahoo Finance via yfinance, matching the established lawful fallback vendor in the Astra acquisition receipt
price_extension.price_field: Adj Close when supplied; otherwise Close only with an explicit QA flag
price_extension.immutability: publish the raw stage3 pre-event extension and acquisition/QA receipt before any stage3 design publication

fresh_placebo_period.calibration: all non-overlapping two-trading-day pseudo-events whose first day is in 2024-01-01 through 2024-06-30
fresh_placebo_period.validation: all non-overlapping two-trading-day pseudo-events whose first day is in 2024-07-01 through 2024-12-31
fresh_placebo_period.prior_rescue_overlap: ZERO because stage1/stage2 consumed only eligible dates from the existing 2025-01-01 onward panel
fresh_placebo_period.expected_return_estimation: exact 200 SPY return dates strictly preceding each pseudo-event

estimand.primary_outcome: two-day CAR[0,+1] from an exact-200 SPY market model
estimand.industry_rule: use SIC4 when exact SIC has >=20 eligible firms, otherwise SIC3 when prefix has >=20, otherwise SIC2
estimand.size_rule: quintiles of pre-event log market capitalization within the eligible analysis sample, fixed before placebo outcomes
estimand.within_block_rule: classify firms by the candidate exposure using global quantile cutoffs; retain only blocks containing at least 5 high and 5 low firms; include block fixed effects in the high-versus-low regression
estimand.equivalent_per_sd_mde: contrast MDE80 divided by the realized mean exposure-z gap between high and low groups
estimand.power_standard: equivalent per-SD validation MDE80 must be <=0.005 return units (0.50 percentage points), unchanged from prior stages

frontier_gate: frontier candidates are admissible only if the already-fixed pre-event frontier nonzero-share remains >=0.25
selection_rule: select the first admissible candidate in frozen order with calibration equivalent-per-SD MDE80 <=0.45pp; validate exactly that candidate once on 2024H2; publish design only if validation equivalent-per-SD MDE80 <=0.50pp
failure_rule: if no candidate passes calibration or the selected candidate fails validation, publish no Design V2, mutate no paper lifecycle state, keep PRE_FREEZE_AUDIT pending, keep Astra outcomes locked, and escalate to research-question/estimand feasibility review rather than another tuning round
